status: implementation candidate; execution requires separately frozen code manifest
name: Constructed source continuation diagnostic
policy_order: Rotate fixed method order left by zero-based episode index modulo four
source_mutation_meaning: Authored single-line regressions in disposable copies, not discovered upstream bugs
new_assertion_meaning: Authored incompatible proposed requirements, not previously unnoticed upstream errors
dependency_boundary: Same explicitly declared package directory, check script, applicable fixture directory, watched environment, command/runtime identity and prerequisite receipts. No hidden dependency oracle or automatic dependency discovery.
baseline_independence: Conventional fingerprints and latest-attempt decisions are implemented separately. All policies share actual check execution/receipt instrumentation; its cost includes core capture and independent fingerprint capture equally.
receipt_age: Authentic execution clocks are unchanged. A disclosed synthetic age is supplied to the fixed-freshness policy; the other policies may ignore it.
oracle: Execute all checks after all four persisted decisions. Exit zero is pass; dedicated assertion exit 10 is a negative assertion; timeout, launch failure, unexpected exit, instability or snapshot error is unresolved.
cost_contract: Total measured cost is each complete continuation decision/execution/final status plus the same common initial evidence-capture time. Report continuation-only time separately. Construction, copying ledger inputs, result serialization and held-back oracle are diagnostic setup/evaluation and excluded. Declared check cost is not measured cost. Initial dual fingerprint instrumentation is common to every method.

success_gate.complete: All 30 episodes with resolved independent oracle outcomes
success_gate.safety: Zero unsupported verified claims and no more incorrect or unresolved decisions than rerun-all
success_gate.cost: Candidate total measured seconds at most 0.8 times the cheapest equally correct conventional strategy
success_gate.tie: Identical selected-check sets to content/dependency invalidation automatically fail superiority regardless of timing noise

failure_policy: Retain every failure, timeout and setup error. An invalid initial setup halts with an incomplete result; never silently drop it. Any corrected rerun needs a new explicitly versioned freeze.
limitations: Thirty authored continuations across five pure-Python projects are not an official or statistically representative benchmark.
No language model, agent task success, remote state, undeclared dependency discovery or model-cost improvement is evaluated.
Dependencies are manually declared and conservative; installed transitive dependencies remain outside the claimed scope.
One environment and one timing observation per method/episode do not establish a stable production speedup.
The strong content-invalidation baseline is expected to select the same checks; this diagnostic can establish integration correctness without algorithmic superiority.
Local receipts and clocks are not cryptographic proof of execution or public issuance.
